class.name: CgameRoadNetwork
class.brief_description: Road graph between sites: Delaunay edges, minimum spanning tree and a few loops.
class.description: [CgameRoadNetwork] is a native port of the GDScript [code]road_network.gd[/code] library. [method connect_sites] builds the Delaunay triangulation of the sites, keeps the minimum spanning tree (Kruskal with union-find) and adds a seeded fraction of the remaining short edges as loops. Degenerate input (collinear or duplicate sites) falls back to all pairs. [method route_cost] scores a straight road by its length and slope.

method.name: connect_sites
method.description: Returns road edges as dictionaries with the keys [code]a[/code] and [code]b[/code] (site indices, [code]a < b[/code]) and [code]length[/code]. The first [code]n - 1[/code] entries are the minimum spanning tree (acyclic, connects all sites); further entries are loop edges. Fewer than two sites give an empty array.

method.name: route_cost
method.description: Returns the travel cost of a straight road from [param a] to [param b]: its length plus [param slope_penalty] metres for every metre of climb, sampled every 4 metres. [param height_at] is a [Callable] taking a [Vector2] and returning a height as [float].
